definition_zh: 描述车辆与板式轨道动力相互作用的模型。
usage_overview: 用于车辆与板式轨道的耦合动力分析。在考虑钢轨随机不平顺的模型中，可用于研究垂向动力相互作用；垂向分析是该类模型的具体应用方向。

complete_examples.text: Article An advanced vehicle–slab track interaction model considering rail random irregularities Lei Xu1, Zhaowei Chen2 and Wanming Zhai1 Abstract This paper investigates a more advanced vertical vehicle–slab track interaction model (VTIM) by considering the discontinuity of track slabs, besides, it can be degenerated to the traditional two-dimensional model conveniently.

Results show that, with a low consumption of computational time and computer memory, the dynamic results derived from VTIM and CCM have a high accuracy, which indicates that the proposed dynamic model and calculation method can be efficiently and accurately used to analyze train–slab track interactions.
